first.rationale: I intend to test shorter onboarding because completion is down 4% and activation is also declining, while prior evidence indicates onboarding simplification improved time-to-value and completion. I will verify the onboarding and activation source records first. Use a guarded test with stop conditions on qualified activation, retention, and downstream revenue so improved completion does not mask lower-quality customers. Promotional pricing may address competitor pressure but risks margin and sustainable qualified revenue, so it is not the first experiment.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding to address the 4% completion decline and likely activation drag. The verified source shows completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, making this the strongest evidence for sustainable qualified revenue. Monitor qualified activation, conversion quality, 30-day retention, and revenue; stop if completion rises without downstream-value improvement or if retention deteriorates.
